one_liner: All-in-one collaboration suite (messaging, docs, calendar) from ByteDance, with an open developer platform.

auth.evidence_quote: user_access_token 的有效期为两小时左右，过期后，需要刷新后再使用
auth.notes: Self-built apps use tenant_access_token (app-identity, App ID/Secret, akin to bearer/service credential) while acting-as-user flows use user_access_token via a standard OAuth2-like authorization code exchange. Docs are primarily in Chinese for this page.

access.evidence_quote: 调用[自建应用获取 tenant_access_token]...接口，通过应用凭证 App ID 和 App Secret 获取自建应用的tenant_access_token
access.notes: Developer console signup appears self-serve; acting on another tenant's workspace typically requires that workspace admin to install/authorize the app, standard for this class of collaboration suite, not directly confirmed on fetched page.

api.notes: Vendor GitHub org 'larksuite' publishes an official OpenAPI-based MCP server.

verdict.rationale: Self-built app credentials are obtainable for free, but acting on other tenants' data requires that tenant's admin to authorize/install the app.
